subject: environmental-science

items.q: Is energy recycled within an ecosystem?
items.correct: No — energy flows through and is lost as heat; nutrients are recycled.
items.why: The Sun constantly resupplies energy; only matter (nutrients) is recycled by decomposers.

items.correct: The variety of all living things and their genes in an area.
items.random_wrong: Just the size of the largest species.
items.why: Higher biodiversity (plants, microbes, animals, genes) usually means more stable, resilient ecosystems.
